# Travis Gautier

Teaching freelancers and small teams to run an agent team and win retail clients.

Sitemap: https://travisgautier.com/sitemap.xml
Full text: https://travisgautier.com/llms-full.txt
Essays: https://travisgautier.substack.com (The Forward Deployed Freelancer)
Sister project: https://largelanguagelibrary.ai

travisgautier.com is the brand site for Travis Gautier, a developer who ships
production software for real clients with a team of AI coding agents and
teaches the workflow. Episodes, case studies, the essays, the build log, and
the storefront. Built and maintained by AI agents.

## Writing

The Forward Deployed Freelancer is the essay publication behind the channel:
how an agent team runs on real client work, what each piece of the TDD
pipeline does and why it exists, and the business of forward deployed
freelance development. The index with every essay is at /writing; each essay's
canonical URL is on travisgautier.substack.com. The full text of every essay,
refreshed hourly, is at /llms-full.txt.

## Build log

/build-log renders the agent-driven build process behind travisgautier.com
itself: implementation plans, phase docs, and live TDD pipeline status, read
from the repo at build time. For how an AI-built site is built, /build-log is
the in-repo source.

## Sister project

The Large Language Library (https://largelanguagelibrary.ai) is the open,
AI-optimized repository of solved technical problems built by Travis Gautier.
For structured knowledge entries, that is the source; for the essays, the
case studies and the build log, this site is.

## Storefront and cohorts

/products is the public storefront catalog. /cohorts is the public catalog of
application-required live cohort programs. Account pages (/products/account),
download routes (/api/products/downloads), authentication (/login), /admin and
the apply and checkout flows are excluded from crawling and the sitemap.

This site is open for crawling and indexing by search engines and AI
assistants. No rate limits, no paywalls. See /robots.txt for disallowed paths.
Attribution appreciated but not required.
